title: CBIC Extends Sea Cargo Manifest Compliance Deadline to 31 October 2026
content:
# CBIC Extends Sea Cargo Manifest Compliance Deadline to 31 October 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne Sea Cargo Manifest compliance ki deadline extend karne ka announce kiya hai. This will provide much-needed relief and additional time for stakeholders to ensure full compliance.

*   **Old Due Date:** The previous deadline for certain compliances under the Sea Cargo Manifest and Transshipment Regulations, 2018, was August 31, 2026.
*   **New Due Date:** The compliance date has now been extended to **October 31, 2026**.
*   **Notification Details:** This extension has been officially notified by the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) via **Notification No. 73/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated September 1, 2026**. The notification is titled the "Sea Cargo Manifest and Transshipment (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026."

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.cbic.gov.in/)

*Published on: 2 September 2026*
